name: lammps-web-gui
description: Run LAMMPS molecular dynamics in your browser: visual input-script builder, MD notebook with an engine checked against native LAMMPS, CMake compiler helper, and a GPU 3D viewer for LAMMPS data/dump, XYZ, PDB and CIF. No install, nothing uploaded.

paragraphs: A free, GPU-accelerated LAMMPS workbench and 3D molecular structure viewer that runs entirely in your browser.
Free for education and non-commercial research · attribution required · commercial use needs a licence
Load LAMMPS, XYZ, PDB and CIF structures by drag & drop and explore them in real-time 3D — no install, no upload, no account.
features: 🧮 MD Notebook — run small simulations in the browser, on the GPU. Type LAMMPS-style input into notebook cells, press Run, and watch the system move in the 3D view while thermo output fills a table and live temperature…

🧪 LAMMPS Workbench — four integrated modules: the MD Notebook above, a visual Script Builder (branching flowchart pipeline over 185 curated commands — the complete general-command surface, locked by a coverage test…
